cohort: All tasks on which over 10% of the original row-split held-out observations have an exact all-input-values duplicate in the same fold development set. Decided by fold memberships and input values alone.
groups: Distinct complete PMLB feature vectors, excluding outcome, originally typed pandas table before imputation. Each group assigned as one unit; conflicting outcomes retained. Do not infer person-level grouping.
outer: StratifiedGroupKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=20261115+offset), first offset in 0..127 giving all classes in each dev and test fold. Same design for inner split with four group folds and random_state=20421+outerfold+offset, use first fold giving all classes in training/ranking. Deterministic feasibility checks use class counts, never predictive outcomes.
method: Exact primary learner and arms. Ranked fits on training subset, ranking held aside, fresh fit on all outer development for testing. RFECV omitted from grouped diagnostic. All retained even if result worse. Emit chosen CV seeds, hashes, conflicting-label counts and per-arm outcomes. 3600s per fold.
